feature_name: Automatic read replica maintenance during self-service maintenance
summary: Cloud SQL automatically updates read replicas when self-service maintenance is performed on the primary instance.
extended_definition: Cloud SQL automatically updates read replicas when self-service maintenance is performed on the primary instance.

supporting_pages.title: Create instances \_|\_ Cloud SQL for SQL Server \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: AUTOMATIC ROTATION DURING MAINTENANCE : With this option, automatic server certificate rotation is enabled during Cloud SQL scheduled maintenance or self-service maintenance updates.

Note: Cloud SQL generates a write endpoint automatically for your Cloud SQL Enterprise Plus edition instance if you do the following: If you haven't already enabled the Cloud DNS API, enable the Cloud DNS API for your Google Cloud project.
SERVER CERTIFICATE ROTATION MODE : For automatic server certificate rotation for your instance, specify AUTOMATIC ROTATION DURING MAINTENANCE .

supporting_pages.title: About read pools \_|\_ Cloud SQL for SQL Server \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: The TDE certificates will be automatically replicated to all read replicas in the read pool, no matter the type of replica.
Like read replicas, read pools receive maintenance during the primary instance's maintenance window.
When you modify read pool node settings such as storage, connectivity, or database configuration flags, the changes are automatically applied uniformly across each read pool node in the read pool.
